# Ronnie Mondal

> Ronnie Mondal, PhD, is a scientist and research development professional. He holds a PhD in Chemistry from Virginia Tech and is a Research Proposal Development Specialist at Tulane University, supporting faculty in preparing competitive federal and foundation grant proposals, with a focus on the School of Science and Engineering. He is a former President of the Virginia Tech Graduate and Professional Student Senate (VT GPSS). He also writes poetry under the name Shehreyar and draws sketches.

Areas of expertise: research proposal development, research administration, higher education governance and institutional policy, data analytics, Python software development, quantitative and computational modeling (including the role of water in protein structure and function).

Name variants: Ronnie Mondal, Ronnie Mondal PhD, Dr. Ronnie Mondal. Poetry pen name: Shehreyar.

## Main pages

- [Home and About](https://ronnie247.github.io/): Overview, publications and contact links
- [Experience](https://ronnie247.github.io/experience.html): Tulane University, Virginia Tech Graduate and Professional Student Senate (President, 2024–2025), Swiggy (Business Analyst), and other roles
- [Education](https://ronnie247.github.io/education.html): PhD in Chemistry (Virginia Tech, 2021–2026); BS in Chemistry (Hons.) with a minor in Biosciences and Bioengineering (IIT Bombay, 2016–2020); three graduate certificates at Virginia Tech
- [Certifications](https://ronnie247.github.io/certifications.html): Professional certifications, including the McKinsey Forward Program and Schrödinger computational courses
- [Awards](https://ronnie247.github.io/awards.html): Honors including the Aspire! Award for Courageous Leadership (2025) and the Graduate Teaching Award (2023)
